objective: Create one OpenWebUI tool wrapper, freyja_core_call, that forwards explicit Freyja Core tool calls to http://100.115.228.56:8510/tools/call.

arguments.tool: Core tool name, for example status.check
arguments.arguments_json: JSON object encoded as a string

bridge_contract.ownership: OpenWebUI only forwards calls. Freyja Core owns calendar, OpenCode, memory, status, and policy logic.

direct_core_acceptance_probe.status_check: Core was reachable at /tools/call earlier in this run and returned ok=true with configured Freyja Core tools and downstream reachability.

live_openwebui_install.initial_blocker: Docker daemon was initially unavailable from this shell: Cannot connect to the Docker daemon at unix:///Users/freyja/.docker/run/docker.sock.
live_openwebui_install.resolution: Docker Desktop was launched with open -a Docker, OpenWebUI reached healthy state, and the upsert was rerun with PYTHONPATH=/app/backend.
live_openwebui_install.apply_command: docker cp ops/openwebui/upsert_freyja_core_bridge_tool.py freyja-open-webui-atlas-open-webui-1:/tmp/upsert_freyja_core_bridge_tool.py && docker exec freyja-open-webui-atlas-open-webui-1 sh -lc 'PYTHONPATH=/app/backend python /tmp/upsert_freyja_core_bridge_tool.py'
live_openwebui_install.backup_behavior: The upsert script copies /app/backend/data/webui.db plus WAL/SHM sidecars to /app/backend/data/backups/freyja-core-bridge-<timestamp>/ before mutation unless --no-backup is passed.

live_openwebui_tool_smoke.method: Loaded the installed freyja_core_bridge tool content from /app/backend/data/webui.db inside the OpenWebUI container, instantiated Tools, and called freyja_core_call.
